images.caption:
Iconostasis of the All Saints Church in Front of Stavrovouni Monastery, Cyprus
Notification: Cameras and Smartphones are strictly forbidden on the Monastery Grounds. You need to leave them at the Reception. When you are caught while taking photos, the Monks will take you Device and keep it, they are mercyless in this Point. Taking Photos in this Church is allowed. Women are NOT allowed at the Monastery Ground and will be hampered to enter.(The Monastery is worth the Visit anyway...for Men) This Church is allowed for Women as well.

images.caption: Perched atop a rocky hill at 750 meters above sea level, Stavrovouni Monastery is one of the oldest monasteries in Cyprus and among the earliest in the Christian world. According to tradition, it was founded by Saint Helena in the 4th century, who brought with her a relic of the True Cross. The monastery’s commanding position offers breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding plains and the sea.
